description: Generate and validate service.json with all dependencies resolved and proper schema compliance

requirements.title: Config Generation
requirements.description: Generate a valid service.json file from user-selected resources, resolving all inter-resource dependencies and populating required configuration parameters with user-provided and default values

validation.notes: TestConfigGenerate, TestConfigGenerateEmptyResources, TestConfigGenerateUnknownResources, TestConfigGenerateInvalidJSON verify config generation

requirements.title: Config Validation
requirements.description: Validate generated and user-modified configuration against resource schemas, checking field types, required values, port conflicts, and dependency compatibility

validation.notes: TestConfigValidate, TestConfigValidateWithDependencyWarnings, TestConfigValidateEmptyConfig, TestConfigValidateUnknownResource verify validation

requirements.title: Config Export
requirements.description: Export the validated configuration to the filesystem and apply it so the Vrooli runtime picks up the new resource settings, with rollback capability on failure

validation.notes: TestConfigExport, TestConfigExportEmptyResources, TestConfigExportBackup verify config export with backup
